Srinagar, Nov 21 (KNS): The Meteorological Department on Saturday forecast generally dry weather across Jammu and Kashmir till November 30, with night temperatures expected to fall by one to two degrees Celsius towards the end of the month.
According to the Meteorological Centre Srinagar, the weather is likely to remain generally dry till November 30, while partly to generally cloudy conditions are expected from December 1 to 3.
The department said minimum temperatures are likely to witness a gradual decline towards the end of November.
Meanwhile, night temperatures increased across most parts of Kashmir on Saturday, with Srinagar recording a minimum temperature of 2.0 degrees Celsius against 0.2 degrees Celsius the previous night.
Pahalgam recorded a minimum temperature of 0.4 degrees Celsius against minus 2.2 degrees Celsius on Friday, while Gulmarg registered 0.4 degrees Celsius against minus 0.4 degrees Celsius.

In Jammu division, Jammu city recorded a minimum temperature of 13.3 degrees Celsius, Katra 12.6 degrees Celsius, Banihal 5.3 degrees Celsius, Batote 7.1 degrees Celsius and Bhaderwah 3.6 degrees Celsius.
The department said no rainfall was recorded at the major weather stations across Jammu and Kashmir during the 24 hours ending at 8:30 am on Saturday.
Day temperatures also remained above normal at several places on Friday, with Srinagar recording a maximum of 16.1 degrees Celsius, Gulmarg 11 degrees Celsius, Pahalgam 14.5 degrees Celsius and Kupwara 18 degrees Celsius.
Jammu city recorded a maximum temperature of 26.5 degrees Celsius, while Banihal and Bhaderwah registered 22.3 and 22.4 degrees Celsius, respectively.
The department has not forecast any significant rain or snowfall across Jammu and Kashmir till the end of November. (KNS)
